# WEEKLY ATOMIC SHOP UPDATE: SEPTEMBER 12-19

Read on if you want to find out what new and great items are currently available in the Atomic Shop, including the free items of the week.

#### FREE ITEMS

Who has time to chop their own meat? The Butch-O-Bot is now until **3. October** free for all Fallout 1st members.

In the military, your hairstyle fits every day! The Tan Military Beret is now free for all players **until September 19th**.
